current_episode.title: Breaking Barriers: Kesi Milligan’s Journey as a Change Maker in Commercial Real Estate

guest.bio_context: Kesi Milligan started her career in radio in 1999 at Carter Broadcast Group before transitioning to residential real estate with a license obtained in 2004. She worked for eleven years at Aflac, then pursued urban studies with an emphasis on community development and housing, graduating in December 2019. At AltCap, a CDFI, she identified a gap in representation for minorities and small business owners seeking commercial real estate guidance, which motivated her transition to commercial brokerage at Select Sites LLC.
